_metadata.description: Fuel and material properties used for substance-aware conversions.

fields.ipcc_category: Fuel category of the 2006 IPCC Guidelines (Vol. 2, Ch. 1) the values belong to
fields.lhv: Lower heating value (net calorific value, NCV) in MJ/kg
fields.lhv_range: IPCC lower and upper limit of the 95 % confidence interval of the NCV, MJ/kg
fields.hhv: Higher heating value (gross calorific value) in MJ/kg
fields.carbon_intensity: CO2 emission factor in kg CO2 per GJ (NCV basis), assuming complete oxidation. For biogenic fuels this is the physical (biogenic) CO2
fields.carbon_intensity_range: IPCC lower and upper limit of the emission factor, kg CO2/GJ
fields.carbon_content: Carbon mass fraction (kg C per kg fuel), used for stoichiometric CO2
fields.hydrogen_content: Hydrogen mass fraction (kg H per kg fuel), used for H2O (indicative)
fields.ash_content: Ash mass fraction (kg ash per kg fuel), indicative
fields.moisture_content: Moisture mass fraction of the as-received fuel
fields.biogenic: True if the CO2 is biogenic; IPCC reports it separately (memo item)

_metadata.consistency: carbon_content = carbon_intensity * lhv / 1000 * 12/44, so that CO2 computed from fuel energy reproduces carbon_intensity exactly (for IPCC fuels: the IPCC Tier 1 default).
_metadata.heating_values: IPCC publishes NCVs only. HHVs of IPCC fuels follow the IPCC rule of thumb (NCV about 5 % below GCV for coal and oil, about 10 % for natural gas).
_metadata.gas_reference_conditions: Gas densities refer to 15 °C and 101.325 kPa; m3 of a gas therefore means a standard cubic metre (Sm3). Use the unit Nm3 for volumes at 0 °C.

coal.name: Coal (steam coal; IPCC other bituminous coal)
coal.source: IPCC 2006 Guidelines Vol. 2 Ch. 1, Tables 1.2 (NCV) and 1.4 (CO2 EF), default values; HHV from the IPCC rule of thumb (NCV about 5 % below GCV)
coal.density_basis: bulk density, indicative (varies with size and moisture)
